text:
Maya R: Quick sync  ACME pilot needs staging run for private deploy. Product asks: dedicated 2-GPU slot, int8 experiment with fp16 fallback, session-only KV cache. Can we sequence safely?

Ethan B: Ops constraints: isolated staging pool only, Tue or Wed morning UTC preferred. Need a temporary quota bump and prewarm policy.

Rohit K: Runtime note: int8 changes memory layout and KV footprint. Session-only KV avoids tenant sharding but may increase latency for warmups.

Dena S: Security: HSM/KMS for cache keys, audit logs on evictions, no outbound calls from model. Need a brief threat assessment before canary.

Maya R: Proposed rollout: (1) lock pool, (2) deploy fp16 baseline 24h, (3) canary int8 (10% sessions) with fp16 fallback, (4) enable session KV soak 48h. Gate each step on perf + sec.

infra-bot: Free window found  staging-acme-2gpu Tue 09:00 UTC for 48h. Reservation created.

Ethan B: I'll file the reservation and bump prewarm to 2 per GPU. batching.window_ms=15 suggested.

Rohit K: I'll open a PR with canary manifest and health checks. Snippet: ```runtime.canary=true
runtime.quant_profile=int8-v2
runtime.kv_mode=session
batching.window_ms=15```

Dena S: I'll review PR tonight. Require separate KMS key for staging, rotate 30d, audits retained 90d. No plaintext cache dumps.

Maya R: Rollback gates: p95 > baseline *1.25 OR any data-leak alert => immediate rollback. Product will hold acceptance sign-off after soak.

Ethan B: Done: reservation + prewarm configured.

Rohit K: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/756. Will wait on security sign-off before canary.

Dena S: Reviewing; two minor changes requested in PR. If addressed, greenlight tomorrow AM.

Maya R: Thanks team. Keeping updates here. :thumbsup:
